scheme_name: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 25 R.I.R. Birds' Unit For Weaker Section
other_conditions: Must be an adult belonging to the economically weaker section of Gujarat
Must provide income proof with the application
Females and beneficiaries below the poverty line are given priority
Must keep the birds safe during night hours
Must ensure regular vaccination of the birds
Must present income and expenditure statements to the government officer during farm visits
Must maintain the bird unit for two years
benefits_summary: Beneficiaries receive a unit of 25 R.I.R. birds along with a 75% subsidy (up to ₹4500) provided as birds and poultry feed.
application_link: Visit the nearest Intensive Poultry Development Project Office or District Poultry Extension Centre, collect the application form, fill in all mandatory fields, attach self‑attested documents (including income proof), and submit to the designated receiving authority for verification.
